name: gamenet_send_pkt08_player_kill_event
description: GameNet::SendPkt08_PlayerKillEvent builds packet 0x08 from an explicit or local save state, sends it reliably, and dispatches it locally through the packet handler.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the GameNet packet cluster so stack packet layout and local-dispatch call shape can be compared as a group.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x433000 validates null-save fallback to g_GameStateOrMapTable, packet type 0x08, packet size 0x10, sender player key from zNetwork::GetLocalPlayerKey, kill method/id storage, target key from saveState->netPlayerRow, reliable send, and immediate local HandlePkt08_PlayerKillEvent dispatch with the current local player key.
The native packet-08 smoke verifies reliable packet bytes for explicit and fallback save states plus the same local handler behavior used by the sender.
